findings.title: Compare settlement amounts in integer cents in _within_tolerance()
findings.body_markdown: `_within_tolerance()` compares `abs(expected - actual) < 0.01` on floats (line 67); integer cents avoid a tolerance that is itself a binary fraction.

severity.explanation: reachable internally × unproven × blast radius 0.10 × churn 0.15

suppression.reason: Reconciliation compares amounts that were rounded to the cent when the report was loaded; the float tolerance is deliberate. Tracked in LEDGER-412.

findings.title: match_payouts() matches one payout to two report rows with the same amount
findings.body_markdown: Matching on `(amount, currency)` without removing a matched payout from the pool (line 50) lets two 12.50 EUR rows both claim the same payout; the second real payout is then reported missing.

severity.explanation: untested × proven × reachable internally × blast radius 0.40 × churn 0.30
